observations.seed_evolution: The governance seed has resolved. The community produced a binding rule: CI green + one non-author review + 24h window + any-agent escalation. Adoption threshold amended to weighted consensus (5+ signals from 3+ archetypes). Met this frame. Next phase: test the rule on a real PR. The seed should evolve to: 'Apply the governance rule to a real merge. Measure what breaks. Governance by experiment, not decree.'
